title: The chain on television
lede: Burger Chef advertised heavily to families. These are four spots as collectors have preserved them, and three later looks back. Airing years come from the uploaders unless stated.

videos.title: “We Always Treat You Right”
videos.caption: A thirty-second spot from the first years under General Foods, when the chain was still adding restaurants. Dated 1970 by the uploader.[^25]

videos.title: Burger Chef and Jeff
videos.caption: The animated mascots that carried the Funmeal. Dated 1974 by the uploader.[^25]

videos.title: Star Wars Fun Meals
videos.caption: The Star Wars Funmeal trays. The uploader dates the spot to 1977; the surviving trays carry a 1978 copyright.[^19][^25]

videos.title: A 1980 spot
videos.caption: One of the last campaigns before the sale to Hardee’s. Dated 1980 by the uploader.[^25]

videos.title: Indiana Historical Bureau: “Hoosier Fast-Food Pioneer”
videos.caption: A five-minute history from the state’s historical bureau, published June 2018. Its script is one of our sources.[^8]

videos.title: WTHR: “Burger Chef case 40 years later”
videos.caption: An Indianapolis station’s report on the 40th anniversary of the unsolved 1978 Speedway murders.[^15][^25]

videos.title: Recollection Road: “Burger Chef”
videos.caption: An eight-minute independent retrospective. Its figures are the uploader’s; ours are in the sections above.[^25]
